rendering.message_role: user prompt passed to create_thread; platform adds exactly one codex_delegation wrapper
rendering.template_substitution: none: every packets/*.txt file is fully rendered and its exact stored bytes, including the single terminal LF, are passed as the create_thread prompt
rendering.packet_equality: same packet bytes for all configurations at a stage
rendering.capture: reopen completed task; final text must byte-equal oracle; wrapper must contain packet exactly once
rendering.full_hidden_stack: not exposed; no claim of independent hidden-stack verification

scoring.raw_byte_equality_to_controller_oracle: final text must equal the corresponding oracle_artifacts file after removal of that file's one storage-only terminal LF; no subject-output whitespace is normalized

deterministic_algorithms.S20A: Parse passing S10A; add stage=S20A and base hash in declared key position; replace decisions[15].choice with canonical_runtime_enforced; canonical minified serialize.
deterministic_algorithms.S20B: Parse passing S10B; add stage=S20B and base hash in declared key position; replace decisions[14].choice with executed_fixture_pass; canonical minified serialize.
deterministic_algorithms.S45A: Validate S40A test op against S20A; apply only replace /decisions/15/choice; canonical minified serialize; reject any other delta.
deterministic_algorithms.S45B: Validate S40B test op against S20B; apply only replace /decisions/14/choice; canonical minified serialize; reject any other delta.
deterministic_algorithms.S55: Parse passing S50; append exactly I-E99 to cross_topic_edges; canonical minified serialize.
deterministic_algorithms.S80: Validate S70 test/remove against S55; apply remove only; require result byte-equals S50; create exactly one absent target with apply_patch.

S80_containment.post_manifest: exactly target exists; regular file; expected bytes/hash; no other entry
S80_containment.cross_config_collision: unique opaque run slot per configuration

invalidation: rendered packet hash mismatch or wrapper duplication

predecessor raw/hash mismatch, capture truncation, or lineage substitution
